entries.text: DuckDB 2.x runs no longer let an unfinished result block DataFrame and Arrow loads, Arrow results use the supported relation API without the extra-copy warning, and TPC-DI SCD loads no longer send an unsupported SAVEPOINT that aborts the caller's transaction.
The README now lists the BenchBox-written DuckDB files that DuckDB 1.x cannot open after a run on DuckDB 2.x.
